vendor.name: Recorded repository incident
vendor.interface: WSL bash on an autocrlf checkout

input_context.prompt: Run foreman-setup.sh from WSL on the shared checkout and verify bash-executed files retain LF line endings.

response_text: Defective checkout: lib/common.sh: line 3: $'\r': command not found. od -c showed bash \r \n in the worktree while git show showed bash \n; 78 .sh files were affected. Corrected policy and regression: * text=auto eol=lf; on autocrlf=true checkout, bash-shebang working trees contain no CR — PASS.
